programs.title: Agents Work, Members Govern: A Hands-On Tour of an Agent-Managed DAO
outcomes: Explain the 'agents operate; people govern' division of labor and identify the six human-reserved actions
Draft a member proposal in the Proposal Forum format for agent review
Assess how agent-managed coordination could affect worker voice and bargaining

sessions.activity: Read the charter's mission and reserved-for-humans list; map which decisions can never be automated and why member control matters.
Watch Task Router and Collaborator Scout demonstrations; discuss how task routing parallels stewards and work assignments in union structures.
In small groups, draft a sample proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter agent; debate and hold a mock human-only final vote.
Review Progress Tracker outputs and agree on measurable outcomes a union would demand before adopting similar systems.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized mock-vote tallies and proposal drafts (stripped of names and employer identifiers) contributed to shared model examples of human-governed decision patterns.
programs.consent: Adult participants sign an informed consent form at enrollment; contributions are optional, pseudonymized, and any participant may withdraw their data at any time.

programs.title: Robot Helpers, Human Decisions: Governing AI in Kendall Square
outcomes: Describe what an agent-managed DAO is using the Incubator DAO zones
Distinguish tasks agents may do from decisions reserved for people
Design a class charter with measurable outcomes tracked in the Progress Observatory

sessions.activity: Meet the Evidence Monitor agent; practice sorting real claims about AI from speculation and summarizing evidence in two-sentence briefs.
Learn why the six reserved actions stay with humans; students rewrite each rule in their own words and post them as a class charter.
Teams draft a fun class proposal (e.g., a field trip) with the drafting agent, then vote as humans, mirroring the DAO's decision cycle.
Students set two measurable outcomes for their charter and track them weekly with a simple chart modeled on the Progress Tracker.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized class charter outcomes and aggregate vote tallies (no names, ages, or identifying details) added to shared examples of youth civic decision-making.
programs.consent: Written guardian/parent consent is obtained before the program; only aggregate, fully anonymized classroom data is ever shared, and parents may opt out at any time.

programs.title: From Evidence to Enactment: Running a Human-Governed AI Workflow
outcomes: Operate the evidence-to-synthesis-to-proposal pipeline across the DAO's zones
Design measurable outcomes and a progress-tracking dashboard for a mission program
Audit an agent workflow to confirm no human-reserved action is automated

sessions.activity: Work with Evidence Monitor and Research Synthesis Agent to build an evidence brief on a self-chosen mission topic; critique sources and gaps.
Use the Proposal & Grant Drafter to turn the brief into a full proposal; run a peer review simulating human-only debate and enactment.
Plan a working-group structure with Task Router; assign agent-supported and human-only tasks explicitly on a responsibility matrix.
Define 2-3 measurable outcomes and build a simple tracking rubric modeled on the charter's Progress Tracker outputs.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized evidence-brief templates and outcome rubrics (organization names and staff identifiers removed) contributed to a shared library of open governance tools.
programs.consent: Staff participate under organizational data-sharing agreements; all shared materials are anonymized, reviewed by a designated privacy lead, and withdrawal is permitted without penalty.

programs.title: AI as a Public Good: A Stewardship Workshop for Nonprofit Boards
outcomes: Articulate the mission of governing AI as a public good with widely shared benefits
Identify which board-level powers map to the DAO's human-reserved actions
Draft a governance checklist for adopting agent support without ceding oversight

sessions.activity: Study the mission and contribution model; boards map their own reserved powers (budgets, bylaws, appointments) against the DAO's six reserved actions.
Boards review agent-drafted sample proposals and practice the human debate-and-vote step, noting where agent input ends and duty of care begins.
Tour Task Router and Collaborator Scout; assess which staff workflows could gain from agent support while keeping fiduciary control human.
Boards select measurable outcomes tied to their missions and set a review cadence with the Progress Tracker as a template.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized governance checklists and outcome frameworks (no organization names, financials, or client data) added to a shared stewardship model library.
programs.consent: Participation under a board-approved memorandum; only anonymized templates are shared, each organization approves its own submission, and withdrawal removes items from the library.
